en: Dependent on a root-cause (hetu) state with a limited object (parittārammaṇa), a non-root-cause (nahetu) state with a non-limited object arises by way of root-condition (hetupaccaya). ... (In all cases, three.
Dependent on a root-cause state with a sublime object (mahaggatārammaṇa), a non-root-cause state with a non-sublime object arises by way of root-condition. ... (In all cases, three.

Dependent on a root-cause state with an immeasurable object (appamāṇārammaṇa), a non-root-cause state with a non-immeasurable object arises by way of root-condition. ... Under root-condition there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.
